type: ({ agentPresentation, status, title, record, recipients, attachments, body, onBodyChange, suggestion, tone, onToneChange, onSend, onDiscard, undoWindow, onUndo, agent, headingLevel, labels, announcement, appearance, }: DraftReviewProps) => JSX.Element
description:
Draft for review (spec section 13.3): the assistant writes a message for a
record, and the person reviews it, edits it and sends it. The host owns the
status, the text and the sending. Send hands over the text on screen, once
per ready status; Ctrl or Cmd+Enter does the same, 500 ms after the text,
the tone, the recipients or the attachments last changed. Undo shows only
while the host holds the message, and a receipt says what was sent, never
that it came back. The polite region says each status change once unless
the host owns announcements.

parameters.name:
{
  agentPresentation,
  status,
  title,
  record,
  recipients,
  attachments = [],
  body,
  onBodyChange,
  suggestion,
  tone,
  onToneChange,
  onSend,
  onDiscard,
  undoWindow,
  onUndo,
  agent,
  headingLevel = 3,
  labels,
  announcement = "polite",
  appearance = "card",
}

agent.description: The agent that wrote the draft, under the title.

agentPresentation.description: Optional avatar, name, identity controls and tray color in the existing header.

announcement.description: Speak status changes politely, or leave announcements to the host.

appearance.description: "card" sits on a tray; "plain" lives on its host's paper.

attachments.type: readonly { id: string; label: ReactNode; }[] | undefined

body.description: The message: the host's growing text while writing, then the draft.

onBodyChange.description: Makes the body a text area while ready without a suggestion.

onSend.description: The text on screen, once per ready status.

record.type: { id: string; customer: ReactNode; amount: ReactNode; overdue?: ReactNode; } | undefined
record.description: The record the draft is about, framed on the tray under the header.

suggestion.type: { title?: ReactNode; segments: readonly DiffSegment[]; decisions: Readonly<Record<string, "accepted" | "rejected">>; onDecisionsChange: (next: Record<string, "accepted" | "rejected">) => void; } | undefined
suggestion.description: An edit to the body, shown as tracked changes while ready.

title.description: The heading; «مسودة للمراجعة» / Draft for review by default.

undoWindow.description:
Whole seconds left in the host's hold before it sends, read when the
countdown mounts. Undo shows only with `onUndo`, while they last.
